notablePrerequisites: All permanents attached to the same creature without summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Manamorphose by paying {1}{R/G}.
Holding priority, activate the creature with Dual Casting and Freed from the Real attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Manamorphose.
Resolve the copy of Manamorphose, adding {U}{R} and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping the creature.
Repeat from step 2.
